items.headline: Blackstone and EQT complete $6.6bn purchase of Platinum Equity's Urbaser
items.summary: Platinum Equity said it has completed the sale of Urbaser, a Madrid-based environmental infrastructure platform, to Blackstone and EQT in a transaction valued at approximately $6.6 billion (roughly €5.6 billion). The sale follows a multi-year transformation process at Urbaser under Platinum Equity's ownership.
items.why_it_matters: The deal shows continued institutional appetite for environmental-services infrastructure at scale, with two of the largest alternative managers taking joint control of a pan-European waste and water platform.

items.headline: Persistent's tender offer for Nagarro succeeds with 83.25% acceptance
items.summary: Persistent Systems said its takeover offer for IT-services firm Nagarro was successful, securing a total of 83.25% of Nagarro's outstanding share capital by the end of the acceptance period. An additional acceptance period runs from September 23 to October 6, 2026, giving remaining shareholders a further window to tender.
items.why_it_matters: Clearing the majority threshold lets Persistent consolidate control of Nagarro's digital-engineering business, extending an Indian IT major's push into higher-value consulting work.

items.headline: AI infrastructure firm Accelevation targets $5.4bn valuation in US IPO
items.summary: Accelevation and its backers are aiming to raise up to $720 million in a US IPO, targeting a valuation of up to $5.4 billion for the data-centre and AI-infrastructure firm.
items.why_it_matters: A successful listing would add to the run of AI-infrastructure companies tapping public markets and test investor appetite for data-centre capacity plays after months of hyperscaler capex headlines.

items.headline: Apollo's Forge agrees to acquire Pamlico-backed Becker's Healthcare
items.summary: Forge, a portfolio company of Apollo, has agreed to acquire Becker's Healthcare, a Chicago-based media and events platform owned by Pamlico Capital, under a definitive agreement advised by JEGI LEONIS. Financial terms were not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: The deal is a sponsor-to-sponsor handoff in healthcare information services, a segment private equity has favoured for its recurring, asset-light revenue.

items.headline: Binance buys $100m stake in Circle, deepens stablecoin partnership
items.summary: Binance has bought a $100 million stake in Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, and expanded its partnership with the company.
items.why_it_matters: The investment ties the world's largest crypto exchange more closely to the leading regulated stablecoin issuer as stablecoins increasingly compete with banks in payments and settlement.

items.headline: Cognex to acquire RealSense, expanding into robotic 3D perception
items.summary: Cognex Corporation has agreed to acquire RealSense, adding a 3D robotic-perception platform to broaden its machine-vision business into the robotics market. Financial terms were not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: The deal signals industrial-automation vendors racing to bolt on perception technology as robotics deployment accelerates in warehouses and factories.

items.headline: Snorkel AI valued at $3.5 billion amid AI training-data demand
items.summary: Snorkel AI has been valued at $3.5 billion, reflecting surging demand for complex AI training data.
items.why_it_matters: The mark adds to a run of rich valuations for data-labelling and training-data specialists as AI developers compete for high-quality, complex datasets.
